commands.command: targeted compatible project-team store/HTTP tests with -race

verifiedBehavior: A project can attach the currently supported single team and the operation is idempotent.
Attaching a different team returns 409 without replacing the existing relation.
Detaching clears exactly the matching relation and repeated detach remains idempotent.
Missing, foreign and grant-excluded projects or teams remain hidden.
Session owner/admin, project:write Bearer, CSRF and read-only scope boundaries are enforced.
